image_description: A small passerine bird, identified as a male Brambling, is perched on the ground amidst green grass and scattered dry leaves. The bird displays characteristic breeding plumage with a black head, orange-rufous breast, and black upperparts with white markings. The background consists of out-of-focus vegetation.
